content.title: How to Start Selling Digital Products with Crypto Payments

content.text: What This Actually Is and Why It Matters: Crypto payment

A crypto payment gateway allows digital creators to accept cryptocurrencies as payment for their digital products. This solution is vital for those excluded from mainstream payment processors. Unlike conventional platforms that charge hefty transaction fees, a crypto gateway like NOWPayments only charges 0.5%. This drastic reduction in fees allows creators to retain more of their earnings, making it easier to sustain their businesses.
How the Architecture Works Under the Hood

The architecture of a crypto payment system consists of several components working together. At its core, it typically includes a hosting service, backend processing logic, and storage for orders. Services like GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages handle the hosting, while backend logic can be managed using Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script. Finally, payment processing through NOWPayments ensures transactions are secure and instantaneous, enabling automatic delivery of digital products.
Who This Is Built For and Why

This infrastructure is designed specifically for digital creators in regions where access to conventional payment processors is limited or non-existent. Whether you are selling ebooks, courses, templates, or other digital products, this solution provides the tools necessary to operate independently. It empowers creators to take control of their sales and revenue without relying on third-party platforms that charge exorbitant fees.
Retain more of your earnings with lower transaction fees.
The Components That Make It Work Together

The successful deployment of a crypto payment gateway depends on integrating various components. Firstly, you need a reliable hosting service like GitHub Pages. Secondly, backend logic through Cloudflare Workers allows for automated processing of orders. Thirdly, a database solution such as Supabase stores order information securely. Finally, NOWPayments handles the cryptocurrency transactions, ensuring that payments are confirmed on-chain without any manual intervention.
How to Use This Knowledge to Deploy Today

To get started with your own crypto payment gateway, first, choose a hosting provider such as GitHub Pages. Next, set up a backend processing system using Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script. Afterward, integrate NOWPayments for seamless crypto transactions. Don't forget to load your digital products and configure your order storage solution with Supabase or Google Sheets. This straightforward approach allows you to launch your digital store in a matter of days.
How do I sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe?

The fastest path to your first sovereign digital product sale is a three-step process. First, create a NOWPayments account — configure your wallet addresses for USDT on Tron and Bitcoin as starting points, generate your API key, and set the webhook endpoint URL. Second, choose your stack: Stack 01 uses GitHub Pages plus Google Apps Script and takes most creators four to six hours following the Sovereign Blueprint at $47; Stack 02 uses Cloudflare Pages plus Workers plus Supabase and is deployed by COREMERCH in 48 hours with the Edge Commerce Stack at $197. Third, upload your product files, set your prices in USD, and run a complete mainnet test transaction before promoting.
Empower yourself with full control over your digital sales.
Related: How Creators Like You Are Building Sovereign Stores

Digital creators selling ebooks, courses, templates, fonts, presets, and beats often reach this infrastructure question after hitting payout restrictions or platform policy problems on Gumroad, Payhip, or Lemon Squeezy. The difference with a sovereign stack is structural: there is no platform relationship to manage, no content policy to comply with, and no payout schedule to wait on. The Edge Commerce Stack at $197 deploys the complete infrastructure in 48 hours under your own accounts. The Sovereign Blueprint at $47 documents the build process for creators who prefer to self-deploy. Both are available at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html.
Your Deployment Checklist

Prepare your product files in delivery-ready format — PDF for ebooks, ZIP archives for multi-file products, exported files for Notion templates, OTF and TTF archives for font families. Set your prices in USD and let NOWPayments handle the crypto equivalent calculation automatically at transaction time. Deploy your stack and configure the product list with file paths, USD prices, and delivery settings. Configure your storefront with product pages and checkout flow. Test the checkout on both desktop and mobile — confirm QR codes generate correctly and live price feeds display accurately. Complete a real mainnet test transaction and confirm the delivery email arrives with a working download link. Check your order database and confirm the test transaction appears with all correct fields.
Frequently Asked Questions
What are the fees associated with using NOWPayments?

NOWPayments charges a low fee of 0.5% per transaction. This is significantly lower than platforms like Gumroad, which charges 10% on every sale. By using NOWPayments, you can retain more revenue from your digital products.
How quickly can I set up a crypto payment gateway?

You can set up a crypto payment gateway in as little as 48 hours using the Sovereign Starter Stack or Edge Commerce Stack offered by COREMERCH. This rapid deployment allows you to start selling your digital products almost immediately.
Can I use this system to sell software?

Yes, this infrastructure is suitable for selling any digital product, including software. By using a crypto payment gateway, you can ensure secure transactions and instant delivery of your software products to customers.
Do I need technical skills to deploy this?
While some technical knowledge is beneficial, the COREMERCH solutions are designed to be user-friendly. The documentation provided helps guide you through each step of the deployment process.
Is there ongoing support after deployment?

Yes, both the Sovereign Starter Stack and Edge Commerce Stack come with 30 days of support. This ensures that you have assistance as you navigate the initial stages of running your digital commerce system.
